purpose: Three proposed finale keyframes for user selection; concept art only

variants.title: A · 小队合力炮
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE polished portrait concept keyframe for the Chinese mobile plush-animal bubble game 泡泡小队, aspect 9:16, approximately 1024x1792. This is a visual proposal for the ultimate/finale move, not a new home page.
Input image 1 is a reference for the CURRENT GAMEPLAY screen: lavender UI, rounded bead board above, pots/characters below. Input image 2 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY and MATERIAL reference: fluffy blue bear in blue pot, orange capybara in orange pot, green frog in green pot, yellow chick in yellow pot, purple elephant in purple pot. Do not reproduce the home-page title or start button from image 2.
Common presentation across the three proposals: full-bleed lavender game background, front-facing camera, no phone bezel. A quiet header band occupies the top 9% for the concept label. The familiar rounded bubble board occupies roughly y=14–49%, showing a partially remaining blue/orange bead mosaic and visibly popping beads at the lower edge. Show the decisive release moment, with characters in the lower half and their attack aimed UP into that board. Dim irrelevant queue cards and hide bottom prop controls during the cinematic. A small caption at the bottom describes the action. The main design must be readable, joyous, powerful, and suitable for this soft toy game.
Rendering: premium 3D plush toy illustration matching image 2, visible short soft fur, stitched felt pots, green felt leaves, rounded friendly faces. Soap bubbles have pearly iridescent thin-film edges. Rainbow effects with distinct cyan, yellow, pink, violet bands, a focused bright core and restrained sparks; keep all character faces clearly visible and preserve board legibility. Show convincing anticipation/recoil in body poses. No weapons made of metal, no photoreal humans, no monkey, no threatening teeth, no sci-fi HUD, no full-screen white haze, no watermarks. No additional menus or competing headlines. Chinese text must be correctly spelled.
Proposal A: TEAM COMBINATION CANNON. EXACTLY FIVE equally important familiar plush partners stand in their flowerpots in a shallow semicircle at y=69–85%: orange capybara and green frog to the left, blue bear in the middle, yellow chick and purple elephant to the right. Blue bear should be only slightly larger, not a giant solo hero. All five are visibly bracing and leaning back from the shared release, eyes focused upward. Five colored strands of energy from each partner converge into ONE iridescent energy bubble floating in front of and ABOVE the group at (50%,58%), diameter about 20% of screen width. That shared bubble becomes the muzzle of a BROAD RAINBOW LIGHT CANNON firing UP into the bubble board, widening into a clear upward fan. The emitted beam is visibly separate from the five thin incoming energy strands. The viewer instantly understands: everybody contributes, one combined blast. A bright circular recoil ripple at the shared bubble and a chain of clean soap-bubble pops along the board's bottom edge convey force. Never place an individual animal inside the shared bubble.
Exact text: at top "A · 小队合力炮". At bottom "全员聚能 → 合力释放". No other required text.

Proposal B: GIANT SUPER BLUE BEAR. A SINGLE huge blue plush bear from reference 2 dominates the lower half, approximately 58% of the screen width, emerging from his familiar blue felt pot with cloud decorations and green leaves. Preserve his rounded cream muzzle and ears and loving plush identity, but give him a determined joyful expression. His two substantial plush arms are both outstretched, palms pushing UP and FORWARD against a giant compressed iridescent energy bubble at y=51–61%. Freeze the powerful moment just after he has thrust the bubble upward: the bubble separates from BOTH hands and surges toward the board with a short thick rainbow wake, TWO expanding curved pressure rings, and clear bead impacts along the board's bottom. His torso leans BACK and his pot tilts a little as a physical recoil, while his hands remain extended. The scene must read as a heavy two-handed push, not blowing from the mouth and not merely holding a ball passively. Four much smaller companions may be faintly visible beside the pot as cheering support, but the giant BLUE BEAR is the unmistakable hero. No crown; his changed pose, scale and strength carry the upgrade.
Exact text: at top "B · 巨型超级小蓝". At bottom "蓄力抱泡 → 双掌猛推". No other required text.

Proposal C: SUMMONED RAINBOW BUBBLE DRAGON. A NEW friendly enormous plush baby dragon has been summoned above the small squad. This is a true DRAGON silhouette, distinctly different from a bear: rounded long snout, tiny soft cream horns, pastel rainbow felt back-spikes, rounded small wings, a visible curling tail and cream belly. Main fur mint-turquoise with lilac accents, all soft fuzzy felt, no hard scales, no aggressive fangs. The dragon floats at y=47–78%, about 65% screen width, angled three-quarter toward the TOP LEFT of the board, its raised head and open mouth clearly visible. It exhales an abundant, broad RAINBOW RIVER OF SOAP BUBBLES upward into the board: a curved stream of distinct iridescent spheres carried on soft rainbow light, visibly emerging from the dragon's mouth, with popping rings at contact. The body pulls backward and wings brace to convey the force of its breath. Along the bottom y=81–90%, the original five plush potted partners remain small but recognizable, their upward colored trails and raised paws make the summoning relationship explicit. A gentle rainbow summoning ring under the dragon. The dragon is an affectionate plush guardian, impressive in size but still cute, coherent with the reference materials.
